notes.title: Engine Update
notes.notes: The Path of Greatest Resistance has now been updated to Unreal Engine 4.15. Along with the engine upgrade comes some changes that are probably not noticeable to the average player, as well as a new feature that's currently "hidden"--but will soon be revealed and accessible at no extra charge through the Steam DLC system.
